video_title: Matthew Dellavedova Joins The Richard Show | NBA Finals 10-Year Reunion

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the 2016 Cavaliers' chemistry and team culture
quotes.excerpt: It was like we were back in 2016.
quotes.quote: The amount of shit talking that went on when we were just hanging out at the pool. It was like we were back in 2016.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on his commitment to the 2016 NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: I just have always wanted to win so bad that I'll push as hard as I can.
quotes.quote: I just have always wanted to win so bad that I'll push as hard as I can to do it. It's funny having kids now and seeing their different personalities and some are just at win at all costs and that's me.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on LeBron James' work ethic and body maintenance
quotes.excerpt: Seeing LeBron how he takes care of his body and stuff is unfair.
quotes.quote: I think I always aim to be, but seeing LeBron how he takes care of his body and stuff is unfair though, bro. That's unfair.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the difficulty of guarding Stephen Curry
quotes.excerpt: It's an impossible task chasing Steph around. He never gets tired.
quotes.quote: Obviously, it's an impossible task chasing Steph around. He never gets tired. Bogut, Draymond, and David Lee are trying to kill me on screens.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the difficulty of breaking into an NBA rotation
quotes.excerpt: It's hard to make a team as an undrafted guy and then to break into a rotation.
quotes.quote: First of all, it's hard to make a team as an undrafted guy and then to break into a rotation is even harder. You never know when your chance is going to come and the season is long and if you can be on a roster, at some point you'll get your shot.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on his breakout game against the Washington Wizards
quotes.excerpt: Coach Mike Brown throws me in, bring a little energy.
quotes.quote: Fortunately, the starters were BSing down 20 something in the second quarter. Coach Mike Brown throws me in, bring a little energy. We make a little run to close the second quarter. Halftime happens, third quarter starters come out, BSing again. I'd already done conditioning with D-Mill three hours before. I'd already had a hard workout with Phil Handy and Mike Miller and so I'm already cooked, but the adrenaline's flowing. They throw me back in, probably six minutes to go in the third quarter. I play the whole rest of the game.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the importance of preparation and readiness
quotes.excerpt: You have to be ready when your opportunity comes.
quotes.quote: You have to be ready when your opportunity comes and you have to be a little crazy. You have to prepare like a psycho so that when your opportunity comes, you're ready to win.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the preparation required for the NBA Finals
quotes.excerpt: The level of preparation and detail in scouting reports, game planning, and then just the pressure.
quotes.quote: I think the level of preparation and detail in scouting reports, game planning, and then just the pressure and the circus that comes with it. It's a crazy media circus and to be able to just focus on your job and turn off the TV is important.

quotes.speaker: Matthew Dellavedova
quotes.summary_phrase: Matthew Dellavedova on the Cavaliers' team chemistry in 2016
quotes.excerpt: We were so dialed in as the units as well.
quotes.quote: I think we were so dialed in as the units as well. Like that second year, we knew exactly what we were running when we got in there and we went together as a unit. So, just being ready to try to change the tempo of the game when we came in and knowing you can go as hard as possible because it's going to be a shorter stint.
